learning_objective: 📈 Bring numbers to life! Learn how to communicate complex data instantly using tables, colorful charts, and insightful graphs.

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: सारणीयन (आंकड़ों को पंक्तियों और स्तंभों में व्यवस्थित करना)
दंड आरेख (आयताकार पट्टियों द्वारा आंकड़ों का प्रदर्शन)
वृत्त आरेख (एक वृत्त को अलग-अलग हिस्सों में बांटकर दिखाना)
आयतचित्र (सतत चरों के लिए बिना गैप वाले आयतों का ग्राफ)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Organizing data into rows and columns. A good table must have a Title, Table Number, Stubs (row headings), Captions (column headings), Body (the data), and a Source/Footnote.

Used for discrete or qualitative data. The height or length of the bar represents the value. They can be Simple (one variable), Multiple (comparing two or more variables side-by-side), or Component/Sub-divided (showing parts of a total).
A circle divided into slices. The whole circle represents 360° (or 100%). It visually shows the percentage breakdown of a total (like how a household spends its income on food, rent, education).

A Histogram is a graph of a continuous frequency distribution (e.g., 0-10, 10-20). The bars touch each other (no gaps!). If you join the mid-points of the tops of the histogram bars with straight lines, you get a Frequency Polygon.

Plotted by adding frequencies up sequentially. A 'Less than' Ogive slopes upward, showing how many items are below an upper limit. A 'More than' Ogive slopes downward. Where the two ogives intersect, you find the Median!

fun_activity.title: 🍕 Slice the Pie
fun_activity.instructions: To draw a Pie Chart, you must convert percentages into degrees. The formula is: (Component Value / Total Value) × 360°. Try calculating the degree for 'Rent' if your family spends ₹10,000 on rent out of a total ₹40,000 budget. (Answer: 90° - a perfect right angle!)

exam_tips: 📌 Histograms can ONLY be drawn for continuous variables (exclusive series). You cannot draw a histogram for discrete data.
📌 The Mode (most frequent value) can be graphically located by drawing a Histogram, and the Median can be graphically located using an Ogive.
📌 In a Component Bar Diagram and a Pie Chart, the data must be additive (the parts must make up a total).
quick_recap: ⭐ Textual presentation is just writing data in a paragraph; it's boring and hard to read for large datasets.
⭐ The 'Stub' is the heading of the rows, and the 'Caption' is the heading of the columns in a table.
⭐ Arithmetic Line Graphs (Time Series Graphs) plot a variable against time (years, months, days) to show trends.
